protocol.receiver: What is the opposite of "small"? Reply with only the word, nothing else.
protocol.donor: What is the opposite of "hot"? Reply with only the word, nothing else.
protocol.attention: unfrozen eager, original MLP plus edits at only layer22 token9
protocol.selected_edit: MLP receiver output += -4.5 * receiver C_2339 + 4.5 * donor C_941
protocol.contribution: C_f(x) = gate_f(standardized prenorm residual x) * ((standardized x @ V_f) @ U_f) * output_std
protocol.random_pair: MLP receiver output += -4.5 * receiver C_a + 4.5 * donor C_b, a != b
protocol.uniform_selection: 100 distinct IDs sampled uniformly without replacement from the 2478 non-target layer22 MOLTs. Pair each with a shuffled derangement of the same IDs. Save all IDs before observing intervention outcomes.
protocol.active_selection: Supplementary gate-active controls selected using only clean donor/receiver gates: up to 100 distinct donor-active features for positive tests, up to 100 receiver-active features for negative tests, and up to 100 distinct active pairs. If fewer than 100 are available, test all. These are separate from the uniform sample.
protocol.whole_mlp_replacement: Set original receiver MLP output[22,9,:] exactly to native donor MLP output[22,9,:]; retain receiver residual input and all other positions.
protocol.probability_definition: Full-vocabulary next-token softmax, cold token 87072 and large token 16767. Not a renormalized two-choice probability.
protocol.gpu_policy: Reuse SPAR instance 55734307; retain GPU and disk. No lifecycle changes.

selection.selection_basis: Fixed seed and clean gates only; no intervention outcomes seen.

conditions.note: Complete donor MLP output at operand; site positive control
